description: Answer key for the ml-basics fixture. Lists the problems deliberately planted in knowledge-tree.json, for checking SourceTrace's output (Day 8 tests, Day 9 comparison). Never give this file to the skill under test.

expected_findings.source_snippet: Supervised learning uses labeled data for training
expected_findings.reason: The definition says no labels are needed; the slide says labeled data is required.
Regression is listed under Supervised Learning, not Unsupervised Learning. Both nodes are correct on their own.

expected_findings.source_snippet: There are three main learning paradigms
expected_findings.reason: Supervised and Unsupervised Learning are sibling paradigms under Machine Learning; neither includes the other.
Deep Learning does not appear anywhere in the slides. The definition is true in general but has no source evidence.

expected_findings.source_snippet: There are three main learning paradigms
expected_findings.reason: The slides name exactly three paradigms under Machine Learning; Deep Learning is not one of them.

expected_findings.source_snippet: Two typical tasks: Clustering ... Dimensionality reduction
expected_findings.reason: The first half of the definition is supported, but the slide names clustering as one of two tasks, not the only one.
The slide's Feedback column differs by paradigm (and is "None" for unsupervised learning), so a single generic definition is unclear.

expected_findings.source_snippet: Dimensionality reduction: compress features while keeping the structure of the data (e.g. PCA)
expected_findings.reason: A main task from the source is missing from the tree. Found by the source-to-tree direction of the audit.
